statement: For every finite simple triangle-free graph $G$, can at most $e(G)-\lambda(G)^2$ edges be deleted to obtain a bipartite graph?

source.reference: Full readings reading-spectral-book-full-v1 (arXiv:2609.20225v2, Lemmas 4.3-4.4 and Theorem 1.9) and reading-edge-spectral-full-v1 (arXiv:2508.15271v2, Theorem 4.1).

observation: Lemma 4.4 of arXiv:2609.20225v2, with booksize zero, proves this for a spectral-radius component; delete all edges of other components to obtain the full statement. This is an established neighbouring result, so it is rejected as a new problem.
